source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When async storage completes with an error reason, CalStorageDatabase creates an NS_ERROR_FAILURE exception, passes its message and object to logError, then rejects with that same exception. logError can add ready-connection diagnostics and the last statement. Cancellation remains a separate NS_ERROR_ABORT rejection. The original report guessed a SQLite-file problem and the patch only improves diagnosis; it does not establish data recovery or corruption repair. No database failure experiment ran.
title: Calendar storage failure logging preserves rejection
